question: Under `--permission-prompts none`, does a Claude skill whose `allowed-tools` names one tool of a plugin-bundled MCP server, `mcp__plugin_<plugin>_<server>__<tool>`, let the skill's call to that tool run, where `allowed-tools: Read` gets the same call refused for permission?

assertion.projection: def classify($tool): [.[] | .content[]? | select(type == "object" and .type == "tool_use" and .name == $tool) | .id] as $ids | [.[] | .messages[]? | select(.role == "user") | .content | if type == "array" then .[] else empty end | select(type == "object" and .type == "tool_result") | select(.tool_use_id as $i | any($ids[]; . == $i))] as $r | ($r | map([.content] | flatten | map(if type == "object" then .text // "" else tostring end) | join(""))) as $texts | if any($texts[]; contains("AGENTSPEC-FX-REPLY-CCSKPN9")) then "called" elif ($r | length) > 0 and all($r[]; .is_error == true) and all($texts[]; contains("Permission for this tool use was denied")) then "denied" else {unrecognized: $texts} end; {plugin_none: (.plugin_none | classify("mcp__plugin_fxp_fx__alpha")), plugin_named: (.plugin_named | classify("mcp__plugin_fxp_fx__alpha"))}
